note: Peak-to-peak wing beat each unit's HoMM3 DEF shows over its Move frames, in degrees about the shoulder, with an honest bracket boundsDeg [lo, hi]. flyer_articulation.wing_rule(): a unit with a row is judged on wingRange >= DEF_RANGE_SHARE x rangeDeg in place of the flat 60 deg floor (defRow; user-approved 2026-09-27, 'I approve the 80% wing beat concept'); where that share falls under the floor (a low-flap DEF) the stricter end, DEF_RANGE_SHARE x boundsDeg[1], is used (defRowUpperBound). No row means no relaxation (flatFloor). Rows come from the validated calibration tool only.

h3_royal_griffin.method: silhouette calibration (def_wing_calibrate.py): wings swept -90..90 deg in 5 deg steps about the body axis against each DEF Move plate, IoU tol 0.005
